svg.text: Ten-fan plate, two rows of five
Ten-fan plate, two rows of five
at position 5 joins the two buses
at position 5 joins the two buses

Cutaway: left side, top and roof removed; the crate's cards plug in from the right-hand side cover, not seen here. Layout from ND Book 2 chapter 8 and ND-05.017 figure 3; size from the 1987 planning manual.
The depth of the drive rack and power crate is not given in the drawings; they are drawn shallow so the parts behind them show.
Drawn schematic, not to exact scale. Sources: ND-B2C8.pdf, ND-B2C8-1987.pdf, ND-B2C3.pdf; ND-05.017 tables 5 and 6.
Colour: red-brown front fascia and greyer brown sides, measured from a photograph of a real Compact.
